properties.name: awskotlin.sqs.endpoint
properties.description: Override the SQS endpoint URL (for example, a LocalStack endpoint). Falls back to awskotlin.endpoint.

properties.name: awskotlin.sqs.region
properties.description: Override the SQS region. Falls back to awskotlin.region, then the SDK default region chain.

properties.name: awskotlin.sqs.listener.auto-startup
properties.description: Whether listener containers start automatically with the application context.

properties.name: awskotlin.sqs.listener.max-concurrent-messages
properties.description: Maximum number of messages processed concurrently per listener.

properties.name: awskotlin.sqs.listener.poll-time
properties.description: Long-poll wait time used when receiving messages. Accepts Kotlin duration format (10s, 500ms) or ISO-8601 (PT10S).

properties.name: awskotlin.sqs.listener.shutdown-timeout
properties.description: Time to wait for in-flight messages to complete on shutdown. Accepts Kotlin duration format (20s, 500ms) or ISO-8601 (PT20S).
